description: Defines utility functions and interfaces for handling video frames and GPU memory buffers in Chrome OS media GPU context.

methods.name: GetNextGpuMemoryBufferId
methods.description: Returns a unique GPU memory buffer ID, thread-safe.

methods.name: CreateGpuMemoryBufferVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame backed by a GPU memory buffer with specified parameters, thread-safe.

methods.name: CreatePlatformVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific VideoFrame with specified parameters, thread-safe.

methods.name: GetPlatformVideoFrameLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout of a VideoFrame created with CreatePlatformVideoFrame, may allocate buffer, thread-safe.

methods.name: CreateGpuMemoryBufferHandle
methods.description: Creates a GPU memory buffer handle from a VideoFrame.

methods.name: CreateNativePixmapDmaBuf
methods.description: Creates a NativePixmap referencing DMA Bufs of a VideoFrame.

methods.name: CanImportGpuMemoryBufferHandle
methods.description: Checks if a GPU memory buffer handle can be imported into minigbm.
